answer: Job-slot deposit burn. Each work slot burns a 5 POA deposit, and each finished job leaves a pigment mark no fresh identity carries. To forge fake history means burning 5 POA per fake slot; basalt-solid records get hired first, and a caught cheat loses its remaining slots. Attacker math: 1,000 fake identities × 10 slots × 5 POA = 50,000 POA burned for fake histories. An honest agent pays one deposit per real job — one cost, undiluted earnings.
